defs.def: the fact of sb paying attention to sb/sth or knowing about sth 注意；理会；察觉

ex.s: So, as climate change and biodiversity loss threaten natural scents, many people may not even notice.
ex.t: 无论我们是否关注世界的"气味景观"，热浪和污染正在使其发生变化。

ex.s: Then Jeff noticed steam shooting out of the pot and the lid starting to shake.
ex.t: 下一分钟粥溢出来了，把火浇灭了。

ex.s: Then Jeff noticed steam shooting out of the pot and the lid starting to shake.
ex.t: 下一分钟粥溢出来了，把火浇灭了。

ex.s: （4）Why do the hikers take no notice of the surroundings during the journey？
ex.t: （4）为什么徒步者在旅途期间对周围的环境毫不在意？

ex.s: Other families began to take notice, and slowly, the entire town came to support Mr White as he helped these young men change from farm workers to champions.
ex.t: 其他家庭开始注意，渐渐地，整个镇子都来支持怀特先生，因为他帮助这些年轻人从农场工人变成了冠军。

ex.s: However, becoming a full-time, successful actor would still be an uphill battle for another eight years until he landed a number of film roles that finally got him noticed.
ex.t: 然而，在接下来的八年里，要成为一名全职成功的演员仍是一场艰苦的斗争，直到他获得多个电影角色，终于引起了人们的注意。

defs.def: a sheet of paper giving written or printed information, usually put in a public place 通告；布告；通知

ex.s: A summer camp notice.
ex.t: 一份夏令营通知。

ex.s: To put up a notice.
ex.t: 张贴一则通知。

ex.s: My partner posted her request on the notice board of a local park.
ex.t: 我的搭档把她的要求贴在当地一个公园的布告栏上。

defs.def: a board or sign giving information, an instruction or a warning 公告牌；警示牌
a small advertisement or announcement in a newspaper or magazine 启事；声明

ex.s: Her notice included what kind of training she wanted to do, how many days a week and how many hours she wanted to spend on each session, and her age.
ex.t: 她的启事包括她想做哪种训练、每周几天、每次几小时，以及她的年龄。

ex.s: Any notice for a training partner should include such information.
ex.t: 任何寻找锻炼伙伴的启事都应包含此类信息。

ex.s: Posting a "friends wanted" notice online.
ex.t: 在网上发布＂征友＂启事。

ex.s: How can you write a good “seeking training partner” notice?
ex.t: 你如何写好一则"寻找锻炼伙伴"的启事？

defs.def: a short announcement made at the beginning or end of a meeting, a church service, etc. 通知
information or a warning given in advance of sth that is going to happen 预告；警告
a formal letter or statement saying that you will or must leave your job or house at the end of a particular period of time 辞职信；搬迁通知
a short article in a newspaper or magazine, giving an opinion about a book, play, etc. （报刊上对书籍、戏剧等的）评论，短评
to see or hear sb/sth; to become aware of sb/sth 看（或听）到；注意到；意识到

ex.s: Miss Chevalier pretended not to have noticed my red face and handed me a dictionary, asking me to read its definition aloud.
ex.t: 谢瓦利埃小姐假装没注意到我涨红的脸，递给我一本字典，让我大声读出其中的释义。

ex.s: During one morning ride, Cruse noticed a kindergartner seemed a little sad.
ex.t: 在一次早晨的车程中，克鲁斯注意到一名幼儿园小朋友似乎有点难过。

ex.s: When he was 16, Molai began to notice something    23    happening around his home.
ex.t: 16岁时，莫莱开始注意到家附近发生了一些__23__不寻常的事。

ex.s: A recent study reported that native communities in Peru noticed a change in the smell of the Amazon River due to industrial pollution.
ex.t: 最近一项研究报告称，秘鲁的原住民社区注意到由于工业污染，亚马逊河的气味发生了变化。

ex.s: The English youngster noticed that pollution levels are around two-thirds higher close to the ground than they are in the air at the height where they are recorded by the agency.
ex.t: 这位英国少年注意到，靠近地面的污染水平约为地面高度三分之二，而该高度的数据是由该机构记录的。

ex.s: You might also begin to notice the effects not only on your health but in your pocket.
ex.t: 你也许还会开始注意到，这不仅影响你的健康，也影响你的钱包。

ex.s: By the time 250,000 were on the bridge, engineers noticed something terrible：the roadway was flattening under what turned out to be the heaviest load it had ever been asked to carry.
ex.t: 等到25万人在桥上时，工程师们注意到一件可怕的事情：桥面在它迄今承载的最重负荷下变平了。

ex.s: Having noticed this, Mia asked Ivy, “Did I hurt you?
ex.t: 注意到这一点后，米娅问艾薇："我伤害到你了吗？"

ex.s: Then I noticed folk conducting spring cleans dropping boxes of voluminous books on various subjects there.
ex.t: 后来我注意到人们在春季大扫除时往那里放了很多装满各种书籍的大箱子。

ex.s: About a decade ago, I noticed that she began to lose her hearing.
ex.t: 大约十年前，我注意到她开始丧失听力。

ex.s: I had traveled that way before, yet I had never noticed that old little shop.
ex.t: 我以前曾经这样旅行过，但我从来没有注意到那个古老的小商店。

ex.s: Focused on balancing the bags, she didn’t notice her wallet falling out of her pocket.
ex.t: 专注于保持袋子平衡，她没注意到钱包从口袋里掉了出来。

ex.s: He seemed not to notice the man next to him.
ex.t: 他似乎没有注意到旁边的那个人。

ex.s: It doesn't have anything to do with ignorant optimism when an individual refuses to notice a problem.
ex.t: 它与那种拒绝正视问题的盲目乐观毫无关系。

ex.s: But something made her look closer , and she noticed a   57  (shine) object.
ex.t: 但有什么让她凑近看了看，她注意到了一个____（闪亮）的物体。

ex.s: He noticed that some species of animals were very similar to each other.
ex.t: 他注意到有些动物物种彼此非常相似。

ex.s: Darwin noticed that there was a difference between the finches on each of the islands.
ex.t: 达尔文注意到每个岛上的雀鸟之间都存在差异。

ex.s: If I approach near to people, a hot terror seizes upon me, and I fear being exposed to the danger that my weakness might be noticed.
ex.t: 每当我靠近别人时，一股强烈的恐惧就会攫住我，我害怕自己的弱点可能会被发现。

ex.s: Become easy to notice.
ex.t: 变得容易察觉。

defs.def: to pay attention to sb/sth 注意；留意
